title: Pricing tier migration & launch ops playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch of revised SKUs, usage limits, and billing communication. This ticket is the canonical ops playbook for migrating existing customers to the new pricing tiers, validating billing behavior, producing release notes and public comms, and completing sales enablement before GA. Goal: zero-regression billing, clear public docs, and <72h rollback plan in case of issues.
acceptance_criteria: All SKU mappings and limit translations tested against 5 representative accounts (trial, small, mid, large, enterprise)
Billing integration smoke tests pass (prorations, invoices, metering) in staging and sandbox
Release notes drafted and approved by Legal and Comms
Sales enablement deck + FAQ published and training session completed
Migration script and rollback procedure vetted and runbook published in Confluence
Monitoring dashboards instrumented with alerts for cost anomalies and billing errors
tasks: Finalize SKU mapping table and publish canonical CSV (owner: Product)
Engineering: implement feature-flagged pricing tier logic and migration job (owner: Eng - Owen Martinez)
Finance: validate billing engine proration logic and invoice samples (owner: Marcy Liu)
Legal/Privacy: confirm MSA/terms compatibility with new limits and communicate required notice (owner: Priya Raman)
Docs: update pricing page, API docs, and developer migration guide (owner: Docs team)
Comms: draft customer emails, blog post, and partner notifications (owner: Comms)
Sales Ops: create enablement deck, objections FAQ, and pricing calculator (owner: Sales Ops)
SRE/Observability: add billing SLO dashboards, alert thresholds, and runbook links (owner: SRE)
Support: update canned responses and escalation flow (owner: Support)
Run migration in staging with synthetic and real customer data; capture metrics and rollback validation
rollout_steps: 1) Feature-flagged deploy to staging; smoke run of migration job
2) Billing validation window (48h) with sample accounts in sandbox
3) Limited pilot: migrate 3 opt-in customers and monitor for 72h
4) Full migration of self-serve customers during low-traffic maintenance window
5) Post-migration verification and open support hotlines for 7 days
6) Public announcement and release notes published after green check
rollback_plan: Toggle feature flag to revert pricing behavior
Run reverse-migration job to restore previous SKU assignments where safe
Open incident channel (pager) and engage SRE, Finance, and Support
Notify affected customers and offer interim credits if invoicing anomalies are found
monitoring_signals: Delta in average invoice amount > 30% vs baseline for 3h
Support intake spike (> 200% baseline) on pricing/billing category
